investigation_notes.Description: The executed PowerShell command queries Active Directory for a group by a specific ObjectGUID, indicating a directed lookup rather than broad enumeration. The script is plaintext (not obfuscated) and matches a prior alert on the same host and user that was investigated and confirmed by IT as a legitimate manual audit by the administrator. Because the command is benign in nature, executed from a management terminal by a known admin, and has a documented prior false-positive disposition, this activity is classified as Low Priority.
